en-US.title: XOS Compass
en-US.subtitle: Field app for live event crews
en-US.promoText: Clock in at the venue, scan badges and gear, report incidents with photos and voice notes, and follow the show. Works offline and syncs when you reconnect.
en-US.description:
Compass is the field app of XOS for the crews, staff and vendors who work live events and productions. Your shift, your scans and your reports are in one place, and Compass keeps working when the venue Wi-Fi does not.

Compass is for people who work with an organization that uses XOS. Your organization, or the production that booked you, sends your invitation. There is nothing to buy in the app.

ON SHIFT
• Clock in, take breaks and clock out with one tap. When your organization asks for it, Compass checks that you are at the venue.
• See today's shifts, call times and day sheet, and claim open shifts in Schedule.
• Follow your shift in a Live Activity on the Lock Screen, and clock in with the Clock In shortcut from Siri or the Action Button.
• Supervisors can turn a shared device into a clock-in kiosk.

SCAN
• Scan credentials at the gate, asset tags and barcodes, and count deliveries as they arrive.
• Type a code when a badge will not scan, and look up anything by its code.

REPORT
• Report an incident in three steps, with its location, photos and a voice note.
• Walk an inspection checklist and open a punch item for anything that fails.

THE SHOW
• Follow the run of show and the next cue, with a full-screen show mode.
• Answer approvals in your Inbox, or straight from the notification.

YOUR TEAM
• Announcements, chat, training, forms, surveys, the crew directory and the help desk, as your organization sets them up.
• Ask Aurora, the XOS assistant, when your organization turns it on.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Offline first: punches, scans and reports save on your phone and upload when you reconnect. The Offline Queue shows what is waiting.
• Your work data on the phone is encrypted, and Face ID or Touch ID can lock Compass.
• Sunlight mode for high contrast outdoors, large text and screen reader support.
• In English and Spanish.

PRIVACY
Compass uses your location only while the app is open, to check you in on site. No ads and no tracking. You can delete your account in the app: More, Settings, Delete Account.
en-US.releaseNotes: The first release of Compass 4.0: clock in on site, scan credentials, assets and deliveries, report incidents and inspections, follow the run of show, and keep working offline.

es-MX.title: XOS Compass
es-MX.subtitle: App de campo para eventos
es-MX.promoText: Marca entrada en el lugar, escanea credenciales y equipo, reporta incidentes con fotos y notas de voz, y sigue el show. Funciona sin conexión y sincroniza al volver.
es-MX.description:
Compass es la app de campo de XOS para el equipo técnico, el personal y los proveedores que trabajan en eventos en vivo y producciones. Tu turno, tus escaneos y tus reportes están en un solo lugar, y Compass sigue funcionando cuando falla el Wi-Fi del lugar.

Compass es para quienes trabajan con una organización que usa XOS. Tu organización, o la producción que te contrató, te envía la invitación. No hay nada que comprar en la app.

EN TURNO
• Marca entrada, toma descansos y marca salida con un toque. Cuando tu organización lo pide, Compass confirma que estás en el lugar.
• Consulta los turnos de hoy, los horarios de llamado y la hoja del día, y toma turnos abiertos en Horario.
• Sigue tu turno en una Actividad en vivo en la pantalla bloqueada y marca entrada con el atajo Marcar entrada desde Siri o el botón de Acción.
• Los supervisores pueden convertir un dispositivo compartido en un quiosco para marcar.

ESCANEAR
• Escanea credenciales en el acceso, etiquetas de equipo y códigos de barras, y cuenta las entregas a medida que llegan.
• Escribe un código cuando una credencial no se pueda escanear y busca cualquier cosa por su código.

REPORTAR
• Reporta un incidente en tres pasos, con su ubicación, fotos y una nota de voz.
• Recorre una lista de inspección y abre un pendiente para lo que no pase.

EL SHOW
• Sigue el orden del show y el siguiente cue, con un modo show a pantalla completa.
• Responde aprobaciones en tu Bandeja de entrada o directo desde la notificación.

TU EQUIPO
• Anuncios, chat, capacitación, formularios, encuestas, el directorio del equipo y la mesa de ayuda, según los configure tu organización.
• Pregunta a Aurora, el asistente de XOS, cuando tu organización lo active.

HECHA PARA EL CAMPO
• Funciona sin conexión: las marcaciones, los escaneos y los reportes se guardan en tu teléfono y se suben cuando vuelves a tener conexión. La Cola sin conexión muestra lo que está pendiente.
• Tus datos de trabajo en el teléfono están cifrados, y Face ID o Touch ID pueden bloquear Compass.
• Modo Sol con máximo contraste para exteriores, texto grande y compatibilidad con lectores de pantalla.
• En inglés y español.

PRIVACIDAD
Compass usa tu ubicación solo mientras la app está abierta, para registrar tu llegada al lugar. Sin anuncios ni rastreo. Puedes eliminar tu cuenta desde la app: Más, Ajustes, Eliminar cuenta.
es-MX.releaseNotes: La primera versión de Compass 4.0: marca entrada en el lugar, escanea credenciales, equipo y entregas, reporta incidentes e inspecciones, sigue el orden del show y sigue trabajando sin conexión.

review.notes:
Compass is the field app of XOS, a work platform for live event and production companies. People join through an invitation from their organization (an employer, or a production that books crew) in the XOS web app. Compass has no purchases and no ads.

DEMO ACCOUNT
The user name and password are in the Sign-In Information fields. The account is a field crew member of a demo organization, with a shift today on a project that has no geofence, so you can clock in from anywhere.

SIGN IN
On the sign-in screen tap "Use Password", enter the demo email and password, and tap "Sign In". Sign in with Apple is offered above Continue with Google.

WHAT TO TRY
1. Today: tap "Clock In" and allow location. Compass records where the punch happened; it never tracks location in the background. Then try "Start Break", "End Break" and "Clock Out". While you are clocked in, a Live Activity shows the shift on the Lock Screen.
2. Scan: pick "Credential" and an access point, then type OWNER_REVIEW_CREDENTIAL_CODE in "Type a code" to see an allowed scan. The camera scans badge QR codes, asset tags and barcodes; typing a code is for badges that will not scan.
3. More, Incidents, "Report Incident": pick a severity, describe what happened, add a photo with the camera or hold the microphone button to record a voice note, then tap "Send Report" (a critical report asks for a hold).
4. Inbox: approvals and announcements. Compass asks for notification permission here, only when you choose to get notifications.
5. Clock In shortcut: say "Clock in with Compass" to Siri, or find it in the Shortcuts app.

PERMISSIONS
Camera: scanning and incident photos. Microphone: voice notes, only while the button is held. Location while using the app: on-site clock in and the incident location. Face ID: optional app lock (More, Settings, Biometric Unlock). Notifications: approvals and announcements. Compass does not track users and has no third-party analytics or advertising.

REPORT AND BLOCK (guideline 1.2)
More, Feed (also a conversation in Chat, and Recognition): tap the three dots on a post, message or shout-out by someone else. "Report This Post" asks for a reason and sends it to the organization's moderators, who review every report within 24 hours in the XOS web app. "Block" hides that person's posts, comments, shout-outs and messages at once. More, Settings, Blocked People lists blocks with Unblock.

ACCOUNT DELETION (guideline 5.1.1(v))
More, Settings, Delete Account. Compass lists the records organizations must keep by law (for example time and pay records), asks for the account email, confirms with Face ID or the passcode, and deletes the account after a two-second hold on "Delete Account". Deletion is refused while the person is clocked in, so clock out first. Signing in with an email link to an address that has no invitation creates an empty account; Compass then shows a screen that explains this and offers Delete Account. Please test deletion with the second account, OWNER_DELETION_TEST_USERNAME, which has the same password as the demo account, so the demo account stays available.
